name: Charlene Brown
bio: Charlene Brown, known as da Tech Conjurer™, is a Songwriter and Digital Music Creator and a Creative Consultant with Brand Misfit™ Media. She brings more than 20 years across tech, brand strategy, and digital communications, along with experience as a Creative Director and Project Manager, to everything she makes. That means a song goes from concept to lyrics to sound to finished release with intention at every step. Brooklyn-rooted and Miami-raised by Caribbean parents, she brings culture, humor, and straight talk to every room. Her work turns brand philosophy into songs people feel. Her rule: clarity creates better choices, so lead with tech and never be led by it.

name: Shirley Ann Felder
bio: Coach Shirley Ann Felder is a motivational speaker, life coach, comedian, bestselling co-author, and songwriter behind Ordinary Greatness. Known as the “Trash Talk Queen,” she draws on more than three decades of entrepreneurship and lived experience to help women release what weighs them down, recycle their lessons, reclaim their power, and rise. Her songs put her words and stories to music, sharing messages of resilience, self-worth, and becoming. With warmth, humor, and truth, she reminds women that their hardest chapters do not get the final word.

name: Clavia Allen
bio: Born in Trinidad and raised in Brooklyn, Clavia Allen now resides in Central Florida. Through her journey, Clavia has grown to know her worth, learning to let go, release what no longer serves her, and embrace each day as a new opportunity. As a servant leader of Chosen31 Essentials, Clavia embodies the mission of empowerment, healing, and growth. She leads with compassion, integrity, and vision, prioritizing the needs of her team and community while fostering an environment of support, transformation, and purpose. Her life and leadership reflect a commitment to helping others recognize their worth, walk boldly in their purpose, and understand that every new day offers another opportunity to become who they were chosen to be.

name: Marcy Trueheart
bio: Marcy Trueheart is a Modern Proverbs 31 Woman, bestselling author, mental health and gun violence prevention advocate, podcaster, affirmation installer, creative, and community servant whose life reflects faith, healing, purpose, and transformation. She co-hosts the Thursday Therapy Podcast, a space for courageous conversations that break mental health stigma, and Elevated H.E.R. (Healing • Elevating • Repositioning), a platform empowering women to heal, rediscover themselves, and step boldly into their next chapter. Her debut album Birthright Alignment, available now across all music platforms, blends healing, self-discovery, empowerment, and ancestral connection through sound. Her signature reminder says it all: “I love you, and there’s nothing you could do about it.”

name: Karon Fayerweather
bio: Karon Fayerweather is a women’s empowerment speaker, coach, two-time bestselling author, and the lyricist and creative visionary behind the album Boldly Becoming Her. Drawing on her own experience of rebuilding in midlife, she helps women—especially Black women—reclaim who they are, make deliberate choices, and create room for the life they want now through her Her Bold Second Act™ framework. Her album carries that message into music, giving voice to the tenderness, courage, and uncertainty of healing and beginning again. With honesty, warmth, and conviction, she reminds women that their next chapter deserves more than their endurance—it deserves their presence.
